prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt bob jet-black hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of four stacked horizontal turquoise neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, joined by one short vertical tube between them, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of lemon-yellow neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: walking toward the camera in a confident mid-stride, one towering heel lifted, both arms swinging loosely at her sides, chin lifted, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy pastel pink leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in pastel pink lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: the Banpo Bridge in Seoul at night with the glowing city skyline and a long row of lit bridge lamps behind; she stands in the middle of the road on the asphalt, car headlights and taillights streaking as long glowing white and red light trails in smooth curves on both sides of her, a deep dark-blue night sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the bridge lights and the glow of the light trails with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot as a long-exposure photograph taken from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height on a tripod, glowing white and red car light trails streaking in long smooth lines across the road around her while she stands perfectly sharp and still in the middle, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the lane markings, a roadside barrier and street lamps around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8 with a 2-second exposure, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
